_source: BIGJRA-style walkthrough text pasted by Vincent, 23 Nov

spector.tip: He wears you down; Mega Banette is his only strong Pokemon
Murkrow + Gothitelle lead: Shadow Tag + Perish Song traps you unless Gothitelle goes down in the first 3 turns
Gothitelle usually Fake Outs turn 1, so one of your leads still gets a hit in
Ninetales: fast, Hypnosis more accurate on this field
Sleep + Perish Song plan: Safeguard, Taunt and similar moves get around it

spector2.tip: Offensive doubles team: tons of strong spread moves (Eruption, Heat Wave, Rock Slide)
Lots of speed tiers: bring speed control such as Tailwind
A Shadow Sneak of your own deals with Typhlosion
Strong spread moves of your own

erick.tip: Ground types are a good defensive option against his paralysis (game tip)
Freezing the field into Icy Field cancels most of its attack and defense boosts (game tip)
Pokémon with Lightning Rod can be useful (game tip)
Outspeed and one-shot Chandelure before Burning Jealousy melts the ice (Colbur Berry counted)

clown.tip: The first three forms hit hard: stall with Protect and Light Screen (guide)
Let it die from Toxic damage: the last form (Porygon-Z, Wonder Guard) holds a Toxic Orb (guide)

flora.tip: Uproot (-2 Sp. Def) makes a defensive wall hard: sweep instead (guide)
Hit with the types super effective on Grass, or field-boosted Dark / Fairy (guide)

florin.tip: Dark and Fairy moves are the key to heavy damage (guide)
Ice moves with Hail are particularly potent (guide)
